TSLRCM was such a trip to wait for. First we got the rushed Xbox release in 2004, which was fun and interesting but incoherent. Then when the PC release happened and Youtube went up we started seeing clips of unreleased content on a few different channels (JediSheml's was the most popular iirc). Then TSLRP was announced by Team Gizka and they kept us in the dark for two years. One of their beta testers leaked a patch around 2008, and then another group picked that up and started working on it as TSLRCM. Fast forward ten years after KOTOR II was released, we finally have a stable and complete release of a restored content mod in the TSLRCM 1.8.X versions in 2014.
